notes_list.title: Ozonolysis of Alkenes
notes_list.basic_overview: Ozone cleaves carbon–carbon double bonds. Reductive work-up commonly gives aldehydes and ketones, whereas oxidative work-up can convert aldehyde-derived fragments further to carboxylic acids.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
Structural clue: replace the C=C bond by carbonyl groups. For CH3CH=CHCH3, reductive ozonolysis gives two CH3CHO molecules. Ozonolysis is widely used for locating alkene positions.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
Ozone adds across the alkene and the ozonide is converted during work-up into carbonyl fragments.
